persons.evidence: śrīmatrūdravarṇṇamahāvihārāvasitaḥ paramopāsaka śrīśākyavaṃṣodbhavaḥ śrīrāmānandena likhitārggamat(!) saṃpūrṇṇaṃ ... śrīrā(m)ānandayā pustaka juro

date.as_written: naipāle hāyane yātaḥ nāgamuṇirasānvite cāṣāḍhe krīna(!)candre tuḥ(!) paṃcamyāñ ca tithau śubhe ... saṃvat 678 āṣāḍa kṛṣ(ṇa) pañcamāhuḥ

notes: The catalogue gives NS 934 as date of copying, but NS 934 refers to a later note about an epidemic (upasarga / mahāmārī). The actual copying date is NS 678 (chronogram: nāga-muni-rasa = 678).
